description: Land Acquisition - Attaragallewa, Elahera D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a specific land parcel (2.429 Hectares in Attaragallewa) for public purpose. It contains detailed land description including boundaries, survey details, and location information. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), the primary focus is on land acquisition matters, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
